title: Olivia Rodrigo's New Album Is So Big, Even a 50-Year Rock Legend Got His First Solo Hit!
summary: Have you ever had a song stuck in your head for days? Now imagine 13 of them—all from the same album—taking over the whole country at once. That's what Olivia Rodrigo just did. Her new album, 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love,' didn't just hit No. 1. It exploded. In its first week, it earned 485,000 'equivalent album units'—a fancy way of counting sales and streams together. That's more than 60% higher than her last two albums, which were already huge. And get this: every single one of the 13 songs landed in the top 30 of the Billboard Hot 100. That's like having a whole soccer team score goals in the same game. The biggest surprise? A song called 'What's Wrong With Me' features Robert Smith, the singer of the legendary rock band The Cure. He's 66 and has been making music for 50 years, but this is his very first solo hit! Olivia is only 23—she's not even old enough to rent a car in some places. Talk about bridging generations. Meanwhile, the top two songs on the chart are still holding strong: Taylor Swift's 'I Knew It, I Knew You' from Toy Story 5, and Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas,' which has been No. 1 for 10 weeks this year. Even 13 Olivia songs couldn't knock it down. And in a sad note, singer Oliver Tree's album re-entered the chart after he died in a helicopter crash. The charts can be a wild mix of joy and heartbreak.
why_it_matters: This shows how music can connect people of all ages, and how one popular album can take over the songs you hear on the radio or streaming.

background_read: Olivia Rodrigo is a pop singer who first became famous with her sad breakup songs in 2021.
Robert Smith is the lead singer of the rock band The Cure, which has been making music since the late 1970s.
The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published every week that shows the most popular songs in the U.S. based on sales and streams.
Article_Structure: WHO: Olivia Rodrigo, Robert Smith, Taylor Swift, and others on the music charts.
WHAT: Olivia Rodrigo's album debuted at No. 1, with all 13 songs entering the top 30, and Robert Smith scored his first solo hit.
WHERE: On the Billboard Hot 100, the main singles chart in the USA.
WHY: The album exploded in popularity, bridging generations of music fans.

perspectives.description: Olivia's new album is amazing, and it's cool that she introduced me to an older singer like Robert Smith.
It's great to see Robert Smith finally get a solo hit after 50 years, but it's a bit strange that it took a Gen Z star to make it happen.
The Billboard charts are interesting because they can show both huge new releases and older songs that become popular again through streams.
